items.zh: 一般来说,机票订得越早越便宜。
items.en: Generally speaking, the earlier you book the flights, the cheaper they are.

items.zh: 这一盛大的赛事将汇聚来自世界各地的运动员,他们将参加32个体育项目的比赛,角逐329个奖牌项目。
items.en: The grand event features athletes from across the world, who will compete in 32 sports, vying for 329 medals.

items.zh: 她的社交媒体账户已成为她影响有志女性科学家的平台,呼吁消除性别歧视。
items.en: Her social media account has become a platform where she influences aspiring women scientists, calling for the elimination of gender discrimination.

items.zh: 太极拳源于古老的道家(Daoist)哲学,适合各个年龄段和体能水平的人练习,已在全球范围内作为一种锻炼、冥想甚至自卫的形式而广受欢迎。
items.en: Originating in ancient Daoist philosophy, Taichi is accessible to people of all ages and fitness levels, and has become popular globally as a form of exercise, meditation and self-defense.
